cohort: 200 pregnant mothers with an unfavorable Bishop score undergoing labor induction
finding: Dinoprostone vaginal insert was associated with a lower cesarean section rate, shorter hospital stay, lower incidence of meconium-stained liquor, and less fetal distress compared to dinoprostone vaginal gel.
mod_finding: Dinoprostone vaginal insert was associated with a lower cesarean section rate compared to dinoprostone vaginal gel.
birth_weight: Measured, but no significant difference found between groups
